affordance.label: dotdiw init
affordance.shape: Adopt the repository: the tracker under your home, keyed to this checkout by one line in .git/config; nothing of it in the repository; the conventions declared and named as yours to commit.
affordance.command:
dotdiw init [--tracker ] [--prefix

] [the adapter's own init flags]

inputMapping.notes: The adapter to adopt under; unsaid, the one the workspace already has, else local. Also DOTDIW_TRACKER.
The id prefix, taken out of the arguments and handed to the adapter as such.
Handed to the adapter: under beads, --stealth, --skip-hooks and --skip-agents are inserted when absent and the rest goes to its init unchanged; under local, nothing is read.

affordance.label: every dotdiw command
affordance.shape: Before whatever was typed, a hook override left by v0.1.0 is unset, and a repository an earlier version adopted in its tree is adopted under the home with the same prefix, once, with the command for the in-tree copy named.

coverage.explanation: Not a command of its own: a repository is unprotected for as long as the override stands, so it does not wait to be asked.
